cues.text: You can't see lead in water. Or cadmium. Or arsenic.
Finding them usually means a lab, a courier, and days of waiting.
A portable potentiostat, built around a precision electrochemical front end.
Cyclic voltammetry. Differential pulse. Square wave. Chronoamperometry. Impedance.
Five laboratory techniques, controlled from your phone over Bluetooth.
AnalyteX runs the sweep. Each peak is a metal, and its height tells you how much.
Results arrive on your phone, checked against Indian drinking-water limits.
Change the electrode, and you change the test.
Heavy metals come first. Formalin, pesticide and soil-nutrient sensors are in development.
AnalyteX. Know what's in your water.
